name: 40830-visionprefill-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one engine with --distributed-executor-backend uni.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 8.3B params: a 32-layer vision tower (hidden 1280, patch_size 14, temporal_patch_size 2, 2x2 spatial merge) over a 28-layer decoder (hidden 3584, 28 query heads, 4 KV heads, head_dim 128, mrope).
load_profile: constant (OPEN loop), rate=8 requests/s, bounded at 1200 requests with a 900 s safety cap, warmup declared as the first 20%.
workload: Synthetic image-heavy prefill: eight 224x224 JPEG gradient images plus a 32-token text prompt per request, four output tokens, temperature 0.0. About 579 prompt tokens per request of which ~88% is picture, and no two requests share a picture.
purpose: A vision assistant captioning eight-image uploads with brief replies, at eight requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 1
distributed-executor-backend: uni

max-model-len: 8192
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.85
enable-prefix-caching: false

# MUST MATCH scenario.json, which emits exactly eight images per request and no video. It is both
# the admission limit and what the engine's startup profiling pass is sized against.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 8, "video": 0}
